descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S11 「深链接：每个模式自己的病历重新打开后还在；另一个模式的 id 永远不渲染、不崩溃」 Deep links: own chart survives a re-open in each context; the other context's id never renders or crashes

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu …（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Fixture patients, chart URLs learned by opening each chart once

When Open /snf/<residentId> directly twice (stands in for a reload); open /snf/<hospitalPatientId> and /rounding/<residentId>; open /rounding/<hospitalPatientId> directly twice

Then Own-context deep links show the chart (no sign-in gate, no blank page). Swapped ids never render the other context's record inside the wrong UI and land on a list or a clear not-found, never an error screen.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: own chart mustContain the patient and its context label (chart-only text proves no sign-in gate); swapped routes mustNotContain the swapped patient and 'Something went wrong'. The 2026-10-10 run found the swapped routes crash to 'Something went wrong on this screen' (snf:get ArgumentValidationError), in both directions. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S11 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
